captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a parametric vacuum tube socket, designed for chassis mounting. It features a central cylindrical body containing an eight-pin octal arrangement around a central keyed index hole. The socket is integrated into a flat, diamond-shaped mounting flange (or footer) with two screw holes located on the outer ears for secure fastening.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric tube socket suitable for 3D printing. The model should include a cylindrical socket body of adjustable height and radius, a configurable number of pin holes arranged in a circle, a central keyed alignment hole with an optional notch, and a flat mounting flange (footer) with two screw mounting holes on either side.
captions.factory: The code constructs the socket using a difference() operation. The positive volume is a union() of a flat mounting flange and the main socket cylinder. The flange is created using a hull() operation over three cylinders: one central cylinder of socket_radius, and two smaller cylinders of radius 5 translated to the left and right sides. The negative volume consists of a for-loop that rotates and translates cylindrical pin holes, a central cylinder for the keyway with an optional cube notch, and two screw holes positioned at the outer ends of the mounting flange.
